arjun.name: 站立重拳 (5HP)
arjun.notes: 1f less recovery on block

arjun.name: 站立中脚 (5MK)
arjun.notes: 2f less recovery on block

arjun.name: 站立重脚 (5HK)
arjun.notes: ; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles

arjun.name: 蹲下重脚 (2HK)
arjun.notes: Fully cancelable sweep with good range; cancel does not allow a combo follow-up on grounded hit or counter-hit (requires Punish Counter or airborne juggle); Punish Counter puts the opponent into a limited juggle OTG bounce state with extra hitstop for an easy hitconfirm; useful juggle tool that keeps the opponent airborne but only has slight juggle potential itself; forward movement leaves Arjun very close to the opponent on block if not canceled; cancel into 236LP creates a safe frame trap on block; Arjun lifts up his front leg hurtbox on frames 6-14, making it strong vs. low pokes; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; extends a projectile invincible head hurtbox upwards on frames 2-17 (but still in a crouching state)

arjun.name: 跳跃轻拳 (j.LP)
arjun.notes: Fast air-to-air with strong horizontal hitbox priority

arjun.name: 跳跃中拳 (j.MP)
arjun.notes: Puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; lower body projectile invuln 8-22f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

arjun.name: 跳跃重拳 (j.HP)
arjun.notes: Cross-up (can connect even from a point blank forward jump); spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; 1st active frame can only hit forward while the final active frame can only hit cross-up (2 separate hitboxes overlap during the middle 4 active frames); extends a large downward hurtbox that makes it vulnerable to otherwise weak anti-airs (like many 5LP/2LP/2MP attacks); lower body projectile invuln 10-22f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

arjun.name: 跳跃轻脚 (j.LK)
arjun.notes: Strong downward hitbox priority; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead if the opponent is in Burnout

arjun.name: 跳跃中脚 (j.MK)
arjun.notes: Greatest horizontal range of Arjun's air normals; lower body projectile invuln 9-26f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

arjun.name: 跳跃重脚 (j.HK)
arjun.notes: Reaches farther downward than Arjun's other air normals (more likely to punish whiffed normals / projectiles / throw techs and harder to anti-air on reaction); knocks down the opponent on any hit (no follow-up combo is possible making it less rewarding than most air normals); lower body projectile invuln 10-21f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

arjun.name: Impose Order
arjun.notes: 3f gap between hits on block; knocks down on counter-hit/Punish Counter (canceling into Super does not combo off the knockdown)

arjun.name: Loose Cannon
arjun.notes: Always a true blockstring; HP/HK follow-ups can only be input on hit

arjun.name: Suppression
arjun.notes: () refers to scaled damage from 5HP~HP combo starter; cannot be input on block; only combos in the corner (opponent is too far to connect midscreen)

arjun.name: Hot Pursuit
arjun.notes: Chases the opponent down for strong midscreen oki; cannot be input on block

arjun.name: Penitent Fist (Hold)
arjun.notes: Allows the TC to combo after a 5HK Punish Counter launch (full charge) or a high anti-air connect (partial charge)

arjun.name: Righteous Verdict
arjun.notes: ; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

arjun.name: Scale of the Judged
arjun.notes: Side switch; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

arjun.name: Excessive Force
arjun.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

arjun.name: Shield of the Vindicator (Block)
arjun.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal.

arjun.name: Shield of the Vindicator (Recovery)
arjun.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal.

arjun.name: Drive Parry
arjun.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

arjun.name: Parry Drive Rush
arjun.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: ? (min/throw), ? (min/block), ? (max/final DR frame)

arjun.name: Drive Rush Cancel
arjun.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

arjun.name: HP Arm of Justice
arjun.notes: 3f extra recovery on whiff

arjun.name: OD Arm of Justice
arjun.notes: 3f extra recovery on whiff

arjun.name: LP Cruel Shoulder
arjun.notes: Launches opponent slightly upward followed by a limited juggle OTG tumble state (can get follow-up near the corner if spaced out); transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 600 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot be made safer on block with meaty timing); Super cancelable on active frames 1-5 (cannot cancel from longer ranges)

arjun.name: MP Cruel Shoulder
arjun.notes: Launches opponent slightly upward followed by a limited juggle OTG tumble state (can get follow-up near the corner if spaced out); transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 700 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot be made safer on block with meaty timing); Super cancelable on active frames 1-5 (cannot cancel from longer ranges)

arjun.name: HP Cruel Shoulder
arjun.notes: Reaches fullscreen; launches opponent upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; switches sides on a midscreen hit unless used from near fullscreen range; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 800 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot gain extra block advantage with meaty timing); Super cancelable on active frames 1-5 (cannot cancel from longer ranges)

arjun.name: OD Cruel Shoulder
arjun.notes: Reaches fullscreen; launches opponent upward followed by a limited juggle OTG bounce state; switches sides on a midscreen hit unless used from near fullscreen range; transitions into Justice Beyond when colliding with an active Divine Pillar; deals 800 recoverable damage on block (stacks with chip damage if the opponent is in Burnout); the active frames end immediately on block/parry or when absorbed by armor followed by a fixed 23f recovery (cannot gain extra block advantage with meaty timing); Super cancelable on active frames 1-5 (cannot cancel from longer ranges)

arjun.name: Justice Beyond
arjun.notes: Occurs automatically when Cruel Shoulder connects with a placed Divine Pillar (startup is counted from the frame Arjun reaches the pillar); will auto-correct if Arjun is behind the opponent when swinging the pillar; no difference between strengths of Cruel Shoulder or Divine Pillar (including OD versions)

arjun.name: Breathing Ring
arjun.notes: No difference between button strengths; projectile dissipates on contact with opponent

arjun.name: OD Breathing Ring
arjun.notes: 2 hits; projectile moves forward slightly while active; can input follow-up even after projectile connects with opponent

arjun.name: Breathing Shockwave
arjun.notes: Button strength determines the projectile angle (LP straight, MP 45 degree angle, HP nearly vertical); shockwave has an initial hitbox in front of Arjun for 10 frames followed by a launched projectile; if the initial Breathing Ring was dissipated on hit/block or by colliding with another projectile, only this short range shockwave will come out (less useful in ranged fireball wars)

arjun.name: OD Breathing Shockwave
arjun.notes: Button strength determines the projectile angle (LP straight, MP 45 degree angle, HP nearly vertical); shockwave has an initial hitbox in front of Arjun for 10 frames followed by a launched projectile; if the initial Breathing Ring was dissipated on hit/block or by colliding with another projectile, only this short range shockwave will come out (less useful in ranged fireball wars)

arjun.name: Divine Pillar
arjun.notes: Button strength determines pillar distance (LK close, MK middle, HK far); holding the button results in a delayed activation

arjun.name: OD Divine Pillar
arjun.notes: Button combination determines pillar distance (LK+MK close, LK+HK middle, MK+HK far); holding the buttons results in a delayed activation

arjun.name: Ghastly Interrogation
arjun.notes: Deals recoverable damage to the opponent (cannot K.O. a low-health opponent); if the opponent already accumulated any recoverable damage, it instead deals actual damage and can K.O. the opponent; can be comboed into on grounded opponents but cannot be canceled into from normals

arjun.name: OD Ghastly Interrogation
arjun.notes: Deals recoverable damage to the opponent (cannot K.O. a low-health opponent); if the opponent already accumulated any recoverable damage, it instead deals actual damage and can K.O. the opponent; takes a step forward on startup similar to 236PP; can be comboed into on grounded or airborne opponents but cannot be canceled into from normals

arjun.name: Indomitable Defense
arjun.notes: Absorbs any strike or projectile attack (including Super Arts) without incurring any recoverable damage; automatically performs a counter-attack when absorbing a strike (but not a projectile); can walk forward or backward while holding button (walk speed: 0.02 in either direction); counter-attack will autocorrect to face the opponent if they switch sides

arjun.name: Moral Breakdown
arjun.notes: 11-hit OD-priority projectile hitbox; can be used to safely pressure without the threat of Drive Impact or reversal SA1

arjun.name: SA: Howling Destruction
arjun.notes: 12-hit Super-priority projectile hitbox; aims near the ground before sweeping outward and upward (less range on early active frames but reaches fullscreen on the final 2 hits); can hit cross-up (even on grounded opponents if they extend a forward hurtbox while behind Arjun); useful juggle ender; can be used as an anti-fireball tool at mid range (less like to punish if clashing with multiple projectile hits)

arjun.name: SA: Yaksha's Order
arjun.notes: Cinematic time regenerates ~2.1 Drive bars for Arjun

arjun.name: SA: Yaksha's Order (CA)
arjun.notes: Available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~2.3 Drive bars for Arjun

arjun.name: Neutral Taunt
arjun.notes: "You challenge me? You stand no chance. Ahh... haha. Your move. Your lack of rhythm disturbs me."; can change which dance Arjun performs by holding a direction (forward/back/up/down) and extend the taunt indefinitely

arjun.name: Forward Taunt
arjun.notes: "One moment. There. Many thanks."

arjun.name: Back Taunt
arjun.notes: "Hmmm. This will not end well for you."; tosses a rock into the air, creating a large projectile hitbox when his breath collides with it; hitbox whiffs on crouching opponents unless they extend a vertical hurtbox; deals 200 recoverable damage on block

ryu.name: 站立轻拳 (5LP)
ryu.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK

ryu.name: 站立中拳 (5MP)
ryu.notes: 2f extra recovery on whiff; useful combo tool with a Target Combo follow-up; extends a wider body hurtbox until the end of recovery

ryu.name: 站立重拳 (5HP)
ryu.notes: Forces stand on hit (allowing Target Combo follow-up to work on crouching opponents); good poke with hitbox priority, many active frames, and a reactable hitconfirm window

ryu.name: 站立轻脚 (5LK)
ryu.notes: Good range for a 5f light (useful in punishes and neutral buffers); DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame

ryu.name: 站立中脚 (5MK)
ryu.notes: Solid poke; front leg hurtbox is raised on frames 4-11 (can avoid low pokes)

ryu.name: 站立重脚 (5HK)
ryu.notes: Whiffs on crouching opponents unless they extend a vertical hurtbox; 2 extra recovery frames on block; good horizontal anti-air that puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state (higher launch on Punish Counter juggle); +11 before Punish Counter crumple state goes airborne; extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles

ryu.name: 蹲下轻拳 (2LP)
ryu.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-5 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air)

ryu.name: 蹲下中拳 (2MP)
ryu.notes: 2f extra recovery on whiff; combo and pressure tool; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-9 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air); extends a wider hurtbox until the end of recovery

ryu.name: 蹲下重拳 (2HP)
ryu.notes: Forces stand on hit; decent anti-air; cannot hit cross-ups; fist hurtbox is invincible to air strikes on frame 9; head hurtbox is invincible to air strikes on frames 10-14; only 1st active frame is cancelable (extends a combo-only hitbox to match the range of the 2nd active frame for combo consistency); () refers to hit/block recovery on 1st active frame only; 5f less hitstun on active frames 2-5 (can be punishable on meaty timing)

ryu.name: 蹲下轻脚 (2LK)
ryu.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK

ryu.name: 蹲下中脚 (2MK)
ryu.notes: DR cancel is delayed until after active frames

ryu.name: 蹲下重脚 (2HK)
ryu.notes: Good range and hitbox priority; has some juggle potential; on block, always plays out a fixed 29f recovery (cannot be made safer with meaty timing)

ryu.name: 跳跃轻拳 (j.LP)
ryu.notes: Can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead

ryu.name: 跳跃中拳 (j.MP)
ryu.notes: Both hits are cancelable to Air Tatsu and put airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; if 1st hit is stand blocked, the 2nd hit will not hit overhead against crouch block; lower body projectile invuln 8-22f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

ryu.name: 跳跃重拳 (j.HP)
ryu.notes: Spike knockdown on counter hit/Punish Counter vs. airborne opponents; lower body projectile invuln 9-23f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

ryu.name: 跳跃轻脚 (j.LK)
ryu.notes: Cross-up

ryu.name: 跳跃中脚 (j.MK)
ryu.notes: Cross-up; lower body projectile invuln 7-20f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

ryu.name: 跳跃重脚 (j.HK)
ryu.notes: Strong jump-in from mid to long range; lower body projectile invuln 10-17f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

ryu.name: Collarbone Breaker
ryu.notes: Counter-hit/Punish Counter/Drive Rush frame advantage applies to both hits; 2nd hit is no longer an overhead if the first hit connects; up to +5 on hit with meaty timing for a meterless combo extension

ryu.name: Solar Plexus Strike
ryu.notes: 2 hits; good forward-moving combo starter and pressure tool; if 1st hit connects on an extended hurtbox, becomes +6 on Counter-hit or +8 on Punish Counter; Counter-hit/Punish Counter frame advantage applies to both hits; can be very advantageous if 1st hit trades with a light normal; 1st hit puts opponent into free juggle state so that the 2nd hit connects (to prevent Ryu from being punishable)

ryu.name: Short Uppercut
ryu.notes: Forces stand on hit; only 1st active frame is cancelable; () refers to hit/block recovery on 1st active frame only; extremely short range makes it finicky in combos; 8f less hitstun on active frames 2-4 (can be punishable with meaty timing)

ryu.name: Axe Kick
ryu.notes: () refers to 2nd hit startup; 1st hit forces stand and puts airborne opponents into a limited juggle state; 2nd hit puts airborne opponents into OTG bounce state; both hits are cancelable; Counter-hit and Punish Counter frame advantage applies to both hits

ryu.name: Whirlwind Kick
ryu.notes: Cancelable to regular/OD Air Tatsu on hit/block; Low Crush on frames 13-20 (not airborne); high pushback on block; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; good juggle option after midscreen OD High Blade Kick for corner carry and oki; proximity guard box begins on frame 2 and reaches the maximum attack range (prevents opponents from walking back out of the attack startup)

ryu.name: High Double Strike
ryu.notes: HK cannot hit vs. crouch block (much more unsafe); cancels to Denjin Charge by inputting 2P on hit only (KD Adv. +10); can juggle into MP/OD Shoryuken or SA3 in the corner

ryu.name: Fuwa Triple Strike 1
ryu.notes: Hits consistently at max 5MP range, but the LK can whiff if 5MP connects on an extended hurtbox; can be spaced safely against most characters for a spacing trap

ryu.name: Fuwa Triple Strike 2
ryu.notes: (refers to scaled damage); 6f gap before HK on block; cancels to Denjin Charge by inputting 2P on hit only (KD Adv. +7)

ryu.name: Shoulder Throw
ryu.notes: Has access to corner throw loops without walking or dashing (whiff 5LP or manually time the next throw); a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

ryu.name: Somersault Throw
ryu.notes: Side switches; no throw/strike oki after back throwing opponent into corner; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

ryu.name: Shingeki
ryu.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

ryu.name: Chest Strike (Block)
ryu.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal.

ryu.name: Chest Strike (Recovery)
ryu.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal.

ryu.name: Drive Parry
ryu.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

ryu.name: Parry Drive Rush
ryu.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.525 (min/throw), 1.878 (min/block), 3.628 (max/final DR frame)

ryu.name: Drive Rush Cancel
ryu.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

ryu.name: LP Hadoken
ryu.notes: 1-hit projectile; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state

ryu.name: MP Hadoken
ryu.notes: 1-hit projectile; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state

ryu.name: HP Hadoken
ryu.notes: 1-hit projectile; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state

ryu.name: OD Hadoken
ryu.notes: 2-hit OD projectile; puts opponent into limited juggle state on hit

ryu.name: Denjin HP Hadoken
ryu.notes: 2-hit projectile; puts opponent into limited juggle state on hit; only comes out when the HP button is pressed

ryu.name: Denjin OD Hadoken
ryu.notes: 3-hit OD projectile; puts opponent into limited juggle state on hit

ryu.name: LP Shoryuken
ryu.notes: Has juggle potential; puts opponent into limited juggle state (can juggle after a high corner anti-air); cannot hit cross-up; does reduced damage and higher juggle limit on active frames 4-10 (weaker as a high-connect anti-air)

ryu.name: MP Shoryuken
ryu.notes: Has juggle potential; cannot hit cross-up; does reduced damage and higher juggle limit on active frames 4-10 (weaker as a high-connect anti-air)

ryu.name: HP Shoryuken
ryu.notes: Has juggle potential; cannot hit cross-up; does reduced damage and higher juggle limit on active frames 3-10 (weaker as a high-connect anti-air); higher knockdown advantage on the first 2 active frames (+37 refers to 1st active frame, +29 refers to anti-air with 3rd active frame; actual advantage varies based on height/distance)

ryu.name: OD Shoryuken
ryu.notes: Has high juggle potential; cannot hit cross-up; only 2nd hit will connect if used too early as an anti-air; extends a combo-only hitbox to make the 1st active frame more consistent

ryu.name: LK Tatsumaki Senpu-kyaku
ryu.notes: Can hit crouching opponents

ryu.name: MK Tatsumaki Senpu-kyaku
ryu.notes: Only 1st hit can connect on crouching (stand blocking 1st hit forces 2nd hit to be blocked, even if crouching); later hits have better KD Advantage

ryu.name: HK Tatsumaki Senpu-kyaku
ryu.notes: Only 1st hit can connect on crouching (stand blocking any hit forces next hit to be blocked, even if crouching); later hits have better KD Advantage; puts opponent into limited juggle state (can juggle afterward if 3rd hit connects)

ryu.name: OD Tatsumaki Senpu-kyaku
ryu.notes: Can hit crouching opponents; puts opponent into limited juggle state; on hit, 1st hit has vacuum effect; on max range block, some hits can drop (-32 at worse)

ryu.name: Aerial Tatsumaki Senpu-kyaku
ryu.notes: Can be input during forward jump; not an overhead; can cross-up (4f less blockstun when landing as a cross-up); at least +3 on block vs. crouching opponents; puts opponent into limited juggle state (can juggle 2HK or SA1); the last 13f of recovery puts Ryu in a crouching state

ryu.name: Aerial Tatsumaki Senpu-kyaku
ryu.notes: Version canceled from 6HK; no follow-up juggle like after jumping Air Tatsu; the last frame of recovery puts Ryu in a crouching state; gives great midscreen oki on a grounded hit (can Dash + 6MP/6HP vs. Back Rise); useful juggle ender after midscreen OD High Blade Kick for damage and corner carry; gives higher KD Advantage on airborne hit (KD +41~46) but knocks the opponent farther away

ryu.name: OD Aerial Tatsumaki Senpu-kyaku
ryu.notes: Can be input during forward jump; cannot hit cross-up; cannot hit crouching opponents (unless they extend a vertical hurtbox), and 1st hit can only hit standing opponents on the final 3 airborne frames of jump; puts opponent into limited juggle state; the last 13f of recovery puts Ryu in a crouching state

ryu.name: OD Aerial Tatsumaki Senpu-kyaku
ryu.notes: Version canceled from 6HK; can hit crouching opponents unlike the jumping version; puts opponent into limited juggle state (follow-up only possible near the corner); the last frame of recovery puts Ryu in a crouching state

ryu.name: LK High Blade Kick
ryu.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state on hit; sets up auto-timed safe jump against cornered opponents; can combo when canceled from any normal except 5LP; the last 2 active frames have identical range (the listed best-case frame advantage is when spaced at max range, active frame 5)

ryu.name: MK High Blade Kick
ryu.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state on hit; can be spaced safely due to its range and high active frame count; 3 extra recovery frames on whiff; the last 3 active frames have identical range (the listed best-case frame advantage is when spaced at max range, active frame 7)

ryu.name: HK High Blade Kick
ryu.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state on hit (can follow up with 623MP, 623PP, or SA3 in corner); Punish Counter tumble state can be hit OTG; has great range and forward movement, making it a useful poke in neutral; the last 3 active frames have identical range (the listed best-case frame advantage is when spaced at max range, active frame 7)

ryu.name: OD High Blade Kick
ryu.notes: Wall Bounce into limited juggle state on hit; if close to corner, opponent flies over Ryu's head

ryu.name: LP Hashogeki
ryu.notes: Strike hitbox but can nullify 1-hit meterless projectiles; puts opponent into spinning juggle state on counter-hit/Punish Counter; excellent Burnout pressure tool (+1 on block, but increased pushback against Burnout)

ryu.name: MP Hashogeki
ryu.notes: Strike hitbox but can nullify 1-hit meterless projectiles; puts opponent into spinning juggle state on counter-hit/Punish Counter

ryu.name: HP Hashogeki
ryu.notes: 2 hits, even if it connects on final active frame; strike hitbox but can nullify 1-hit meterless projectiles; puts opponent into spinning juggle state on hit; leaves Ryu inside throw range for a strike/throw mixup on block

ryu.name: OD Hashogeki
ryu.notes: Strike hitbox but can nullify 1-hit OD projectiles or any meterless projectiles; great pressure tool

ryu.name: Denjin HP Hashogeki
ryu.notes: () refers to recovery on block; strike hitbox but can nullify 2-hit meterless projectile; puts opponent into spinning juggle state on hit; only comes out when the Heavy Punch button is pressed

ryu.name: Denjin OD Hashogeki
ryu.notes: 1-hit; strike hitbox but can nullify 1-hit OD projectile or any meterless projectile; crumple state is +14 before opponent becomes airborne

ryu.name: Denjin Charge
ryu.notes: Charges up next fireball-based move (Hadoken, Hashogeki, SA1, SA2) into a more powerful Denjin version; Ryu is in a counter-hit state for the entire animation; gains the Denjin charge on frame 50; can only store 1 stock at a time (does not persist between rounds); can also be performed after 5HP~HK or 5MP~LK~HK (on hit) by inputting 2P

ryu.name: SA: Shinku Hadoken
ryu.notes: 5-hit Super projectile; button strength does not affect projectile speed; opponent cannot jump over projectile after Super freeze if within ~1/2 screen; can be preformed even when an OD Hadoken is on screen

ryu.name: SA: Denjin Hadoken
ryu.notes: 8-hit Super projectile; button strength does not affect projectile speed; opponent cannot jump over projectile after Super freeze if within ~1/2 screen; consumes Denjin stock for slightly more damage and KD Advantage; can be performed even when an OD Hadoken is on screen

ryu.name: SA: Shin Hashogeki Lv.1
ryu.notes: Can hold the button to charge to a higher level for more damage (in exchange for less invincibility); if button is held up to 5f after Super freeze, this invuln is extended up to the 2nd active frame (up to 18f); strike hitbox; Burnout chip damage does not changed based on charge level

ryu.name: SA: Denjin Hashogeki Lv.1
ryu.notes: Can hold the button to charge to a higher level for more damage (in exchange for less invincibility); if button is held up to 5f after Super freeze, this invuln is extended up to the 2nd active frame (up to 18f); strike hitbox; Burnout chip damage does not changed based on charge level; consumes Denjin stock for slightly more damage

ryu.name: SA: Shin Hashogeki Lv.2
ryu.notes: Loses 4 invincibility frames if held; invincibility can be reduced to 1-7f if the button is held the minimum length of time for Lv.2 charge (6f after Super freeze); strike hitbox; Burnout chip damage does not changed based on charge level

ryu.name: SA: Denjin Hashogeki Lv.2

ken.name: 站立重拳 (5HP)

ken.name: 站立重脚 (5HK)

ken.name: 蹲下轻拳 (2LP)

ken.name: 蹲下中拳 (2MP)

ken.name: 蹲下重拳 (2HP)

ken.name: 蹲下轻脚 (2LK)

ken.name: 蹲下中脚 (2MK)

ken.name: 垂直跳跃重脚 (8HK)

ken.name: Triple Flash Kicks 1

ken.name: Triple Flash Kicks 2
ken.notes: (refers to scaled damage); 2f gap between final 2 hits on block; whiffs on crouch blocking opponents (much more unsafe); 2f worse KD Adv. if only the final hit connects

ken.name: Knee Strikes

ken.name: Hell Wheel
ken.notes: Side switches, has great corner carry; does not allow throw/strike oki after back throwing opponent into corner; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

ken.name: Flame Strike
ken.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

ken.name: Lightning Crack (Block)
ken.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal.

ken.name: Lightning Crack (Recovery)
ken.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal.

ken.name: Drive Parry
ken.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

ken.name: Parry Drive Rush
ken.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.745 (min/throw), 2.449 (min/block), 3.721 (max/final DR frame)

ken.name: Drive Rush Cancel
ken.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

ken.name: LP Hadoken

ken.name: MP Hadoken
ken.notes: 1-hit projectile; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state

ken.name: HP Hadoken
ken.notes: 1-hit projectile; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state

ken.name: OD Hadoken

ken.name: LP Shoryuken

ken.name: LK Tatsumaki Senpu-kyaku

ken.name: MK Tatsumaki Senpu-kyaku

ken.name: LK Jinrai Kick

ken.name: OD Jinrai Kick

ken.name: OD Kazekama Shin Kick

ken.name: OD Senka Snap Kick

ken.name: Run~Dragonlash Kick

ken.name: SA: Shinryu Reppa

luke.name: LP Sand Blast
luke.notes: 1-hit projectile, travels ~50% screen length; [] refers to projectile active time; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state on Counter-hit/Punish Counter

luke.name: MP Sand Blast
luke.notes: 1-hit projectile, travels ~66% screen length; [] refers to projectile active time; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state on Counter-hit/Punish Counter

luke.name: HP Sand Blast
luke.notes: 1-hit projectile, travels ~91% screen length; [] refers to projectile active time; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state on Counter-hit/Punish Counter (can juggle into 623LP/SA2 deep in the corner or into SA1 from a specific range)

luke.name: OD Sand Blast
luke.notes: 2-hit OD projectile, full screen length; puts opponent into limited juggle state; can follow up with PP for 1 extra Drive bar; extends a projectile invuln hurtbox on frames 19-36 (more vulnerable to ranged jumps and anti-projectile moves)

luke.name: Fatal Shot
luke.notes: 1-hit OD projectile; costs 1 extra Drive bar; () refers to scaled damage after 236PP connects; causes a wallsplat on hit (can combo near the corner, or whiff 236K~P to safely gain ground); extends a projectile invuln hurtbox on frames 10-32 (more vulnerable to ranged jumps and anti-projectile moves)

luke.name: LP Rising Uppercut
luke.notes: Reduced damage and higher juggle start/increase/limit on active frames 3-10; cannot hit cross-up; does not juggle into SA3 despite being cancelable; much higher juggle limit than other versions of Rising Uppercut (useful in corner juggles)

luke.name: MP Rising Uppercut
luke.notes: Reduced damage and higher juggle start/increase/limit on active frames 3-10; cannot hit cross-up; does not juggle into SA3 despite being cancelable

luke.name: HP Rising Uppercut
luke.notes: Reduced damage and higher juggle start/increase/limit on active frames 2-10; cannot hit cross-up; does not juggle into SA3 despite being cancelable

luke.name: OD Rising Uppercut
luke.notes: Reduced damage 3rd active frame of 1st hit (will only do 1 hit for 600 damage on later active frames); cannot hit cross-up; can cancel into PP follow-up on hit for 1 Drive bar; 2nd hit whiffs vs. crouch block (reduced chip damage, worse advantage)

luke.name: Slam Dunk
luke.notes: Follow-up on hit only for 1 additional Drive bar; can whiff against high juggled opponent; counts as a separate hit for damage scaling

luke.name: LP Flash Knuckle
luke.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; no head hurtbox on frames 6-17 for improved anti-air; the final 2 recovery frames are cancelable on Hit into specials/Supers (enables a corner juggle into 623LP or SA2)

luke.name: LP Flash Knuckle (hold)
luke.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; canceling to SA3 will cause juggle to whiff; 1f more recovery on hit/block; no head hurtbox on frames 6-29 for improved anti-air

luke.name: LP Flash Knuckle (perfect)
luke.notes: Hold LP 18-20f for perfect version; launches opponent high into a limited juggle state; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; canceling to SA3 will cause juggle to whiff; 1f more recovery on hit/block; no head hurtbox on frames 6-29 for improved anti-air

luke.name: MP Flash Knuckle
luke.notes: Leaves opponent standing on hit, very slightly out of throw range; knocks airborne opponents far away into a limited juggle state

luke.name: MP Flash Knuckle (hold)
luke.notes: Wall Bounce on hit for a limited juggle state; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; higher KD Adv when farther from wall (opponent may bounce over Luke's head if too close to the wall); SA3 cancel only juggles properly in corner; 1f more recovery on hit/block; cannot combo naturally when canceled from 2HP

luke.name: MP Flash Knuckle (perfect)
luke.notes: Hold MP 18-20f for perfect version; Wall Bounce on hit for a limited juggle state; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; higher KD Adv. when farther from wall (opponent may bounce over Luke's head if too close to the wall); SA3 cancel only juggles properly in corner; 1f more recovery on hit/block; perfect timing allows natural combo from 2HP cancel

luke.name: HP Flash Knuckle
luke.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state (can only juggle into canceled SA3); worse KD advantage vs. airborne opponents (+31 when juggled after 5LP~MP~HP); can cancel into SA3 on reaction if opponent attempts a Drive Impact; pulls back hurtbox on frames 5-15

luke.name: HP Flash Knuckle (hold)
luke.notes: 1f extra recovery on hit/block; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; cancelable into SA3 on reaction if opponent attempts a Drive Impact; pulls back hurtbox on frames 5-25; leaves opponent close on block for a 2LK~2LP hitconfirm or a 1f microwalk into throw (slightly longer if opponent walks back)

luke.name: HP Flash Knuckle (perfect)
luke.notes: Hold HP 18-20f for perfect version; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; 1f more recovery on hit/block; cancelable into SA3 on reaction if opponent attempts a Drive Impact; pulls back hurtbox on frames 5-25; leaves opponent close on block for a 2LK~2LP hitconfirm or a 1f microwalk into throw (slightly longer if opponent walks back)

luke.name: OD Flash Knuckle
luke.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; active frames 3-4 can nullify normal 1-hit projectiles; listed recovery is for blocked/whiffed version (on hit, automatically transitions to 2nd hit); 1st hit is cancelable into PP follow-up for 1 extra Drive bar on hit only; can juggle directly into any Super (canceling into Super will cause SA3 to whiff; SA2 will whiff on final cancelable frame)

luke.name: DDT
luke.notes: Costs 1 extra Drive bar on 214PP 1st hit only (cannot activate on block or when armor absorbed); leaves Luke close enough to walk in for a strike/throw mixup; counts as a separate hit from 214PP for damage scaling; in juggles, only connects on opponents low to the ground and will not come out if opponent is juggled higher

luke.name: Aerial Flash Knuckle
luke.notes: Can be input during forward/neutral jump (or back jump when canceled from j.MP); 7f extra landing recovery on whiff if input during the first 32 jump frames; Luke is in a crouching state from 4th landing recovery frame onward; improved frame advantage when done lower to the ground, and spaced out at farther ranges; can only be up to -1 on block if not precisely spaced; can partially charge the attack and release early for better juggle advantage after 214[LP]

luke.name: Aerial Flash Knuckle (hold)
luke.notes: Can be input during forward/neutral jump (or back jump when canceled from j.MP); the final 12 recovery frames are in a crouching state; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state (can follow-up with 623LP if opponent is juggled at max height)

luke.name: OD Aerial Flash Knuckle
luke.notes: Can be input during forward/neutral jump (or back jump when canceled from j.MP); the final 12 recovery frames are in a crouching state; puts the opponent into a limited juggle state; kara-canceling the startup with j.214P~PP can affect Luke's trajectory and frame advantage

luke.name: Avenger
luke.notes: Follow-up P or K can be input on frames 12-32; Luke is in a counter-hit state for entire duration; Total Distance: 2.23 (0.82 before the earliest follow-up timing)

luke.name: OD Avenger
luke.notes: Armor does not apply to follow-up attacks; follow-up P or K can be input up to frame 32; follow-up can start immediately after armor hit freeze without waiting for any additional Avenger startup frames to occur; Luke is in a Punish Counter state for entire duration; Total Distance: 2.47 (0.75 before the earliest follow-up timing)

luke.name: No Chaser
luke.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; very late connect to juggle into 623LP/MP, SA1, or SA2 (otherwise, can only cancel into SA3)

luke.name: OD No Chaser
luke.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state; very late connect to juggle into 623LP/MP, SA1, or SA2 (otherwise, can only cancel into SA2 or SA3); midscreen, later active frames canceled into SA2 will whiff

luke.name: Impaler
luke.notes: First 2 active frames can only hit airborne opponents; 3rd active frame hits grounded and gives the best KD Advantage (cannot hit meaty to allow a follow-up juggle); Luke is in a crouching state for entire recovery duration; puts opponents into limited juggle state; 5f extra recovery on whiff

luke.name: OD Impaler
luke.notes: First 2 active frames can only hit airborne opponents; Luke is in a crouching state for entire recovery duration; puts opponent into limited juggle state (airborne hit will always juggle at least as high as a grounded hit)

luke.name: SA: Vulcan Blast
luke.notes: 5 hit Super projectile, first 4 hits travel 65% screen, final hit goes fullscreen; higher KD Adv. when farther from wall; extends a projectile-vulnerable hurtbox during startup frames 2-5 (more difficult to use as an anti-fireball tool)

luke.name: SA: Eraser
luke.notes: Extremely fast super that works well in juggles; in the corner, gives Luke an auto-timed strike/throw/shimmy mixup; on hit, the animation is not invincible until the very end (can be hit by delayed projectiles like Kimberly Spraycan or JP Amnesia orbs); Full Dmg distribution: 300x3,200x6,900

luke.name: SA: Pale Rider
luke.notes: Luke runs forward; active frames occur upon reaching the opponent or on frame 27 (whichever occurs first) but invincibility is not extended when far from opponent; has juggle potential; on block, bounces away with a fixed recovery period (whiff recovery is 26f slower); cinematic time regenerates ~2 Drive bars for Luke; takes opponent to Memphis

luke.name: SA: Pale Rider (CA)
luke.notes: Luke runs forward; active frames occur upon reaching the opponent or on frame 27 (whichever occurs first) but invincibility is not extended when far from opponent; has juggle potential; on block, bounces away with a fixed recovery period (whiff recovery is 26f slower); cinematic time regenerates ~2.3 Drive bars for Luke; available at 25% HP or below; does not take opponent to Memphis

luke.name: Neutral Taunt
luke.notes: "Come on!"

luke.name: Forward Taunt
luke.notes: "Yeah! Let's let it fly!"

luke.name: Back Taunt
luke.notes: "Hadooken!"

cammy.name: 站立轻拳 (5LP)
cammy.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; extended hurtbox appears for 2f before active; DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame

cammy.name: 站立中拳 (5MP)
cammy.notes: Can get frame advantage with meaty timing and leads to good conversions on counter-hit; decent Drive Rush starter (links to 5HP on hit, frame traps into itself) but doesn't carry much forward momentum; extended hurtbox remains for 4f after active frames

cammy.name: 站立重拳 (5HP)
cammy.notes: Great disjointed hitbox; moves Cammy far forward during startup, giving it good range but making it easier to whiff punish; good Drive Rush starter (good momentum, links into 4MP~HK if close enough or frame traps into 5LP/2LP)

cammy.name: 站立轻脚 (5LK)
cammy.notes: Good range for 5f punishes and light conversions; extended hurtbox appears for 2f before active; special/DI cancel is delayed until after active frames (prevents OD Spiral Arrow combo); DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame

cammy.name: 站立中脚 (5MK)
cammy.notes: Great ranged poke, vulnerable to DI if predicted; extended hurtbox remains for 7f after active frames, making it somewhat more whiff punishable

cammy.name: 站立重脚 (5HK)
cammy.notes: 2f extra recovery on whiff; great ranged poke; Punish Counter knockdown gives great corner carry and can juggle into Cannon Spike in the corner (623MK is most consistent but can whiff at longer ranges); extends a hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles; crouch-sized hurtbox on frames 1-28; particularly vulnerable to Drive Impact in neutral; can anti-air some long range jump-ins; has high juggle potential (causes air reset when juggled into)

cammy.name: 蹲下轻拳 (2LP)
cammy.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; extended hurtbox appears for 2f before active; DR cancel is delayed until after active frames

cammy.name: 蹲下中拳 (2MP)
cammy.notes: Good counterpoke and useful combo filler after 2HP or CH 5LP/2LP/5MP; 3f extra recovery on whiff; extends a wide hurtbox during recovery on whiff

cammy.name: 蹲下重拳 (2HP)
cammy.notes: Forces stand; Good for starting pressure, especially with meaty timing (236HK + Dash 2HP sets gives enough advantage to link 5HP); extended hurtbox appears for 2f before active; situationally useful anti-air

cammy.name: 蹲下轻脚 (2LK)
cammy.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; low hitconfirm starter; extended hurtbox appears for 2f before active and remains 5f after active

cammy.name: 蹲下中脚 (2MK)
cammy.notes: Great ranged cancelable low poke; very useful when canceled to DR; extended hurtbox appears for 1f before active and remains 6f after active; special/DR/DI cancel is delayed until after active frames

cammy.name: 蹲下重脚 (2HK)
cammy.notes: Disjointed hitbox gives it some neutral utility; has juggle potential (KD +37~39); extended hurtbox remains for 6f after active frames

cammy.name: 跳跃轻拳 (j.LP)
cammy.notes: Quick air-to-air

cammy.name: 跳跃中拳 (j.MP)
cammy.notes: Puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; cancels into j.214K/j.214214P on forward jump only; low blockstun means there will always be a blockstring gap if canceled; lower body projectile invuln 6-28f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

cammy.name: 跳跃重拳 (j.HP)
cammy.notes: Causes spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; good hitbox disjoint near Cammy's fists; lower body projectile invuln 8-35f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

cammy.name: 跳跃轻脚 (j.LK)
cammy.notes: Cross-up; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead (except vs. Blanka)

cammy.name: 跳跃中脚 (j.MK)
cammy.notes: Long hitbox can work as a ranged air-to-air; lower body projectile invuln 7-30f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

cammy.name: 跳跃重脚 (j.HK)
cammy.notes: Good jump-in from long range, especially mixed with empty jump or j.214K to bait anti-airs; can air-to-air from long range; lower body projectile invuln 10-35f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

cammy.name: Lift Uppercut
cammy.notes: Forces stand (required for 4MP~HK TC); useful anti-air starting on frame 6 but can often trade or whiff against close jumps; extended arm hurtbox on active frames 3-5 is anti-air invulnerable; combos naturally from 5LP/2LP/5MP at close range; frame traps into 5LP/2LP for a CH confirm into 2MP; useful approach out of Drive Rush (sets up a microwalk throw on block or a link to 5HP); low pushback allows a 214PP cancel to cross-up anywhere on screen (even when starting with DR~4MP, 4MP); active frames 3-5 cannot hit crouching opponents (however, meaty setups timed to hit on the 3rd active frame can be crouch blocked for +3 advantage if the opponent does not input a reversal crouching normal)

cammy.name: Assault Blade
cammy.notes: Whiffs on crouching opponents; jump cancelable on hit only; puts opponents into limited juggle state on hit (free juggle if started from Drive Rush)

cammy.name: Delayed Ripper
cammy.notes: 5f extra recovery on whiff/block; pulls back hurtbox on frame 5-14 (auto-shimmy tool); low blockstun means that DR Cancel is the only way to make it safe; extended hurtbox remains for 9f after active frames; special/DI cancel is delayed until after 2nd recovery frame; DR cancel is delayed until after active frames; can juggle into DRC~5HP~HK on normal hit or 214LP on Punish Counter for strong juggle routes

cammy.name: Lift Combination
cammy.notes: Whiffs on crouch blocking opponents (works on crouching hit because 4MP forces stand); jump cancelable on hit only; puts opponent into limited juggle state; has 5f more recovery than 4HK on its own, resulting in more limited juggle follow-ups

cammy.name: Swing Combination
cammy.notes: 2 hits; leaves a 9f gap between 1st and 2nd hit on block; 1st hit of HK is cancelable into j.214K (9f gap) or SA2; 2nd hit acts as a cancelable grounded normal; 2nd hit is cancelable into Supers after 5 recovery frames and into specials/DI/DR after 7 recovery frames

cammy.name: Rough Landing
cammy.notes: Can walk for a manually-timed corner throw loop; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

cammy.name: Delta Throw
cammy.notes: No throw oki after corner side switch; can use Drive Rush 5MP (+3 oB, links to 5HP on hit), or Drive Rush 2MP to set up trade combo vs. reversal 4f normals; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

cammy.name: Leg Scissors Choke
cammy.notes: Can get throw oki if opponent is near the corner (no oki midscreen even with Drive Rush)

cammy.name: Spin Raider
cammy.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

cammy.name: Countersnipe (Block)
cammy.notes: Performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 5f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; see Drive Reversal.

cammy.name: Countersnipe (Recovery)
cammy.notes: Performed by holding 6HPHK on wakeup; 5f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); see Drive Reversal.

cammy.name: Drive Parry
cammy.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

cammy.name: Parry Drive Rush
cammy.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 0.603 (min/throw), 2.027 (min/block), 2.796 (max/final DR frame)

cammy.name: Drive Rush Cancel
cammy.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

cammy.name: LK Spiral Arrow
cammy.notes: Can be spaced safely; useful in corner juggle routes after 5HP~HK, DR~4HK > 4HK, or blocked Drive Impact

cammy.name: MK Spiral Arrow
cammy.notes: Can be spaced safely; best version for buffers in neutral; useful in corner juggle routes into 623K

cammy.name: HK Spiral Arrow
cammy.notes: Only 1st hit is super cancelable (very low damage route); holding HK results in a powered up version

cammy.name: HK Spiral Arrow (Hold)
cammy.notes: Switches sides on hit; puts opponent into limited juggle state; super cancel comes out on 4th hit; button must be held 16f for fully charged version; can combo from CH 5HP or PC 2MP; has a crouch-sized hurtboxes on frames 17-26 (but still considered standing)

cammy.name: OD Spiral Arrow
cammy.notes: Switches sides on hit; puts opponent into limited juggle state

cammy.name: LK Cannon Spike
cammy.notes: Shortest horizontal range (good close-range anti-air but can whiff in grounded combos); () refers to damage and juggle limit on active frames 3-12; SA3 cancel whiffs on hit; cannot anti-air cross-ups

cammy.name: MK Cannon Spike
cammy.notes: Medium horizontal range (good all-purpose anti-air and juggle ender); () refers to damage and juggle limit on active frames 3-12; SA3 cancel whiffs on hit; cannot anti-air cross-ups

cammy.name: HK Cannon Spike
cammy.notes: Longest horizontal range (good for long range anti-airs and neutral jumps; best grounded combo ender); () refers to damage and juggle limit on active frames 3-12; SA3 cancel whiffs on hit; cannot anti-air cross-ups

cammy.name: HK Cannon Spike (Hold)
cammy.notes: Long horizontal range (but can drop when canceled from max range 5HP); () refers to damage and juggle limit on active frames 5-12 (becomes 1 hit if these frames connect); switches sides on hit; first hit can successfully juggle to SA3; button must be held 15f for fully charged version; can combo from CH 2MP; cannot anti-air cross-ups

cammy.name: OD Cannon Spike
cammy.notes: Long horizontal range (good for punishes and long range anti-airs); () refers to damage and juggle limit on active frames 4-12 (becomes 1 hit); cannot anti-air cross-ups

cammy.name: LP Quick Spin Knuckle
cammy.notes: Puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state (keeps opponents closer than other versions and has some juggle potential); good frame trap from 5HP (2f gap) that leads to Counter-hit confirm

cammy.name: MP Quick Spin Knuckle
cammy.notes: Puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state

cammy.name: HP Quick Spin Knuckle
cammy.notes: Puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state

cammy.name: OD Quick Spin Knuckle
cammy.notes: No collision box on frames 1-10 (can cross-up from close range); cross-up version is 3f slower and 5f worse on block (no difference on hit); puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state

cammy.name: Cannon Strike
cammy.notes: Forward jump only; cancelable from j.MP; button strength affects dive trajectory (LK short, MK mid, HK far); spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; HK version worst-case frame advantage is 1f better than LK/MK versions; 2f extra hitstun and blockstun if it connects on the final 2 active frames before landing (screen shake occurs, guaranteeing an advantage of at least +10/+4)

cammy.name: OD Cannon Strike
cammy.notes: Forward jump only; cancelable from j.MP; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; hitconfirm reaction time is longer the higher the divekick connects (cancelable until landing); frame advantage on hit/block is fixed when connecting on the first active frame (e.g. as a corner throw escape); 2f extra hitstun and blockstun if it connects on the final 2 active frames before landing (screen shake occurs, guaranteeing an advantage of at least +10/+6)

cammy.name: Hooligan Combination
cammy.notes: Startup refers to earliest/latest follow-up input timings; trajectory depends on button strength (LP short/high, MP middle, HP far/low); LP and MP versions can cross over close standing opponents; HP version can cross over close crouching opponents

cammy.name: HP Hooligan Combination (Hold)
cammy.notes: Startup refers to earliest/latest follow-up input timings; button must be held 18f for fully charged version; can cross over crouching opponents; follow-ups gain properties of OD versions (except for SA2 cancelability)

cammy.name: OD Hooligan Combination
cammy.notes: Startup refers to earliest/latest follow-up input timings; button combination affects trajectory (LP+MP=LP, LP+HP=MP, MP+HP=HP); follow-ups have enhanced OD properties

cammy.name: Razor's Edge Slicer
cammy.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state on hit; low profile 50-63f; crouching state during recovery

cammy.name: Razor's Edge Slicer (HP Hold)
cammy.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state on hit; low profile 68-96f; crouching state during recovery

cammy.name: OD Razor's Edge Slicer
cammy.notes: Puts opponent into limited juggle state on hit; low profile 50-80f; crouching state during recovery

cammy.name: Hooligan Cannon Strike
cammy.notes: Startup refers to earliest timing from Hooligan; button strength affects divekick trajectory (LK short, MK medium, HK far); spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; autocorrects toward opponent after crossing over

cammy.name: Hooligan Cannon Strike (HP Hold)
cammy.notes: Startup refers to earliest timing from Hooligan; button strength does not affect divekick trajectory; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; autocorrects toward opponent after crossing over

cammy.name: OD Hooligan Cannon Strike
cammy.notes: Startup refers to earliest timing from Hooligan; button strength does not affect divekick trajectory; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; autocorrects toward opponent after crossing over

cammy.name: Reverse Edge
cammy.notes: 236P trajectory affects frame advantage (lower height is better); up to 3f more recovery before landing (depends on activation height); does not autocorrect toward opponent after crossing over; crouching state during landing recovery

cammy.name: Reverse Edge (HP Hold)
cammy.notes: 2 hits; causes OTG bounce vs. airborne opponents that can juggle into 623MK/HK/KK or SA1/SA3 Super (low height juggle connect will not allow time for follow-up); does not autocorrect toward opponent after crossing over; crouching state during landing recovery

cammy.name: OD Reverse Edge
cammy.notes: 2 hits; causes OTG bounce vs. airborne opponents that can juggle into 623MK/HK/KK or any Super (low height juggle connect will only allow canceled Air SA2 to connect); does not autocorrect toward opponent after crossing over; crouching state during landing recovery

cammy.name: Fatal Leg Twister
cammy.notes: Throws standing opponents only; 15% damage increase on Punish Counter; up to 8f more total recovery before landing (depends on activation height); crouching state during landing recovery; extends a proximity guard box that immediately forces a crouch blocking opponent's hurtbox to reach its crouching height, preventing uncrouchable meaty setups (but can still throw opponents that hold straight down on wakeup)

cammy.name: Fatal Leg Twister (HP Hold)
cammy.notes: Throws standing opponents only; puts opponent into limited juggle state; 15% damage increase on Punish Counter; up to 2f more total recovery before landing (depends on activation height); crouching state during landing recovery; extends a proximity guard box that immediately forces a crouch blocking opponent's hurtbox to reach its crouching height, preventing uncrouchable meaty setups (but can still throw opponents that hold straight down on wakeup)

cammy.name: OD Fatal Leg Twister
cammy.notes: Throws standing opponents only; puts opponent into limited juggle state; 15% damage increase on Punish Counter; up to 8f more recovery before landing (depends on activation height); crouching state during landing recovery; extends a proximity guard box that immediately forces a crouch blocking opponent's hurtbox to reach its crouching height, preventing uncrouchable meaty setups (but can still throw opponents that hold straight down on wakeup)

cammy.name: Silent Step
cammy.notes: Stops forward trajectory; recovery before landing depends on activation height; Cammy is in crouching state during recovery; useful for baiting reversals in setups where throw/overhead/divekick could hit meaty

cammy.name: Silent Step (HP Hold)
cammy.notes: Stops forward trajectory; recovery before landing depends on activation height; Cammy is in crouching state during recovery; useful for baiting reversals in setups where throw/overhead/divekick could hit meaty

cammy.name: OD Silent Step
cammy.notes: Stops forward trajectory; recovery before landing depends on activation height; Cammy is in crouching state during recovery; useful for baiting reversals in setups where throw/overhead/divekick could hit meaty

cammy.name: SA: Spin Drive Smasher
cammy.notes: Great combo tool with high juggle potential and corner carry; 5th hits transitions into launching follow-up on hit only; damage distribution: 100,200x3,100,200,1000

cammy.name: SA: Killer Bee Spin
cammy.notes: Can escape grounded meaty attacks, but usually results in Cammy whiffing over opponent's head; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state (no cinematic), number of airborne hits varies based on juggle height; Drive Damage distribution: 900x3-x7,3000; only deals 250 damage on the first hit if it trades

cammy.name: SA: Aerial Killer Bee Spin
cammy.notes: Forward jump only; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state (no cinematic), number of airborne hits varies based on juggle height; non-cinematic Drive Damage distribution: 900x3-x7,3700; only deals 250 damage on the first hit if it trades

cammy.name: SA: Delta Red Assault
cammy.notes: Full screen anti-projectile move (can lose to slow projectiles at max range); combos from charged 623[HP], 214P, or 236HK 1st hit when canceled into; cinematic time regenerates ~1.9 Drive bars for Cammy; only deals 500 damage on the first hit if it trades (only the first 5 active frames are invincible)

cammy.name: SA: Delta Red Assault (CA)
cammy.notes: Full screen anti-projectile move (can lose to slow projectiles at max range); combos from charged 623[HP], 214P, or 236HK 1st hit when canceled into; available at 25% HP or below; cinematic time regenerates ~1.9 Drive bars for Cammy; only deals 500 damage on the first hit if it trades (only the first 5 active frames are invincible)

cammy.name: Neutral Taunt
cammy.notes: "Sigh... Do you plan to fight at all?"

cammy.name: Forward Taunt
cammy.notes: "Time to meet your maker."

cammy.name: Back Taunt
cammy.notes: "(Biiiig stretch)"

chunli.name: 站立轻拳 (5LP)
chunli.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; combos naturally to 5MP; Stance Cancel: -1/-8; special/DR/DI cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame

chunli.name: 站立中拳 (5MP)
chunli.notes: Good combo/frame trap starter; Stance Cancel: +3/-1; special/DR/DI cancel is delayed until after 3rd active frame

chunli.name: 站立重拳 (5HP)
chunli.notes: Great long-ranged poke and whiff punish tool; cancelable into Stance and can input follow-ups after 16f; combos naturally to Stance LP if close enough, or stance MK/HK on Punish Counter; Stance Cancel: +6/+1 into follow-up, -4/-9 into blocking

chunli.name: 站立轻脚 (5LK)
chunli.notes: Stance Cancel: 0/-3; DR cancel is delayed until after 2nd active frame

chunli.name: 站立中脚 (5MK)
chunli.notes: Cannot hit crouching opponents; good anti-air (cannot hit cross-up); Stance Cancel: +9/+4

chunli.name: 站立重脚 (5HK)
chunli.notes: Cannot hit crouching opponents; slow but rewarding mid-range anti-air (leg/head are invulnerable to airborne strikes 14-16f); cannot hit cross-up; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; Stance Cancel: +10/+6 into follow-up, -3/-7 into blocking

chunli.name: 蹲下轻拳 (2LP)
chunli.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; Stance Cancel: -1/-6

chunli.name: 蹲下中拳 (2MP)
chunli.notes: 1f extra recovery on whiff; decent range and hitbox disjoint for a poke; Stance Cancel: +6/+1; topmost hurtbox on frames 1-9 is vulnerable only to aerial strikes (preventing its use as an anti-air)

chunli.name: 蹲下重拳 (2HP)
chunli.notes: 2 hits (only 2nd is cancelable); forces stand on hit; solid anti-air on frames 12-13 and 21-23 (cannot hit cross-up); 1st hit puts airborne opponent into limited juggle state (2nd hit causes air reset, but can whiff for a knockdown); counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage applies to both hits; Stance Cancel: +8/+4 into follow-up, -6/-10 into blocking

chunli.name: 蹲下轻脚 (2LK)
chunli.notes: Chains into 5LP/2LP/2LK; fully cancelable (rare for a 2LK); Stance Cancel: -3/-4

chunli.name: 蹲下中脚 (2MK)
chunli.notes: Good range for a cancelable low poke; Stance Cancel: +5/+2; DR cancel is delayed until after active frames

chunli.name: 蹲下重脚 (2HK)
chunli.notes: 2f extra recovery on block; more active frames than most sweeps (can be as safe as -4 with meaty timing); puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state (can juggle after late anti-air 2HK); Stance Cancel: KD/-11 into follow-up, KD/-21 into blocking

chunli.name: 跳跃轻拳 (j.LP)
chunli.notes: Fast downward-angled air-to-air; can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead vs. Dee Jay/JP/Marisa/Zangief

chunli.name: 跳跃中拳 (j.MP)
chunli.notes: 2 hits, can only connect once vs. grounded opponents; both hits put airborne opponents into limited juggle state; cancels to Air Lightning Legs or Air SA1 from either hit; lower body projectile invuln 7-22f (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

chunli.name: 跳跃重拳 (j.HP)
chunli.notes: Puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state (300 less damage vs. airborne); cancelable into j.HP~j.HP even on whiff; lower body projectile invuln 9-23f (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

chunli.name: 跳跃轻脚 (j.LK)
chunli.notes: Fast upward-angled air-to-air

chunli.name: 跳跃中脚 (j.MK)
chunli.notes: Cross-up; lower body projectile invuln 6-20f except around attack hitbox (cannot be used to avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

chunli.name: Jumping Heavy Kick
chunli.notes: Can be used as a fuzzy instant overhead vs. JP/Marisa/Zangief (opponent must be in Burnout for true blockstring); lower body projectile invuln 8-19f and 8-25f on kicking leg (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

chunli.name: 垂直跳跃重脚 (8HK)
chunli.notes: Hits on both sides, preventing the opponent from walking under for a punish; useful air-to-air; lower body projectile invuln 8-19f and 8-25f on kicking legs (if used immediately on the way up, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

chunli.name: Wall Jump
chunli.notes: Counter-hit state during entire duration; can be done from Back or Neutral jump if fully against the wall, or after Forward Jump against a cornered opponent

chunli.name: Swift Thrust
chunli.notes: Great poke and neutral buffer tool with a disjointed hitbox and lenient hitconfirm window; Stance Cancel: +5/+1; DR cancel is delayed until after active frames

chunli.name: Hakkei
chunli.notes: Short range combo and frame trap tool; high active frame count makes it amazing as a meaty option; Stance Cancel: +9/+3 into follow-up, -5/-11 into blocking

chunli.name: Water Lotus Fist
chunli.notes: Stance Cancel: +3/-2 into follow-up, -5/-10 into blocking; 1-8f crouching state; does not allow a follow-up link (except for Punish Counter 3HP into Stance LP); puts airborne opponent into limited juggle state (e.g. after Wallsplat)

chunli.name: Yokusen Kick
chunli.notes: Punish Counter crumple state can lead to Stance HK launch or Stance LP grounded combo; causes spinning free juggle state on Punish Counter vs. airborne opponents; great hitbox priority; Stance Cancel: +2/-1 into follow-up, -6/-9 into blocking; extends a lower-body hurtbox 1f before active that is vulnerable to projectiles

chunli.name: Falling Crane
chunli.notes: Side-switching overhead; can only hit cross-up (does not work on fully cornered opponents); puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; 1f better hit advantage vs. most crouching characters; has extremely long range when performed out of Drive Rush

chunli.name: Yoso Kick
chunli.notes: Not an overhead, but can hit immediately on the way up to bait throw techs; cancelable into itself on hit/block (up to 3 total uses) or into other air moves; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; can hit cross-up (bounces away from wall if opponent is fully cornered); lower body projectile invuln 3f~land (if used immediately on the way up and whiffs, can avoid the 2nd hit of JP's OD Amnesia bombs)

chunli.name: Soaring Eagle Punches
chunli.notes: Can be performed on whiff; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state

chunli.name: Yoso Kick 2
chunli.notes: Cancelable into itself on hit/block (up to 3 total uses) or into other air moves; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; can hit cross-up (bounces away from wall if opponent is fully cornered)

chunli.name: Yoso Kick 3
chunli.notes: Cancelable into other air moves on hit/block but cannot chain into any further Yoso Kicks; causes spike knockdown vs. airborne opponents; can hit cross-up (bounces away from wall if opponent is fully cornered)

chunli.name: Serenity Stream
chunli.notes: Crouching state 14-22f, then low profiles until exiting stance; follow-ups can be input on frame 15 at the earliest; counter-hit state for entire animation; if no follow-up, stays crouched for 57f (hold crouch to extend); can block while crouching (cannot block overheads, as this leads to Stance Exit); blocking an attack immediately exits stance and allows a Drive Reversal; can take longer to enter stance when canceled from heavy normals, giving much worse frame advantage if a follow-up is not used immediately

chunli.name: Serenity Stream Exit
chunli.notes: Input Up (or another 214P) to manually exit stance (fastest total Serenity Stream time is 37f); cannot block while exiting stance; counter-hit state for entire animation; final 14f of recovery is in a standing state; 18f version occurs automatically after 14+57f (can delay by holding crouch); when Stance Exit occurs automatically after LP/LK/MK stance attacks, the total exit duration is increased and Chun can stand block before the final 18f recovery period

chunli.name: Orchid Palm
chunli.notes: No charge required to cancel into Kikoken or Spinning Bird Kick; [] refers to recovery when exiting Serenity Stream; slight low profile for entire move duration; special/DR/DI cancel is delayed until after 4th active frame; on Perfect Parry, Chun-Li is forced to exit the stance (2f less total recovery on PP) and is in a Punish Counter state during the entire stance exit animation; when automatically transitioning into Stance Exit, Chun-Li can block for the first 2 transition frames (except on Perfect Parry)

chunli.name: Snake Strike
chunli.notes: Low profile/upper body projectile invuln: 1-31f (exit stance) / 1-36f (remain crouched); extra-low profile 8-21f (can even go under Drive Impact); [] refers to recovery when exiting Serenity Stream; () refers to KD Adv. when exiting Serenity Stream on hit; on Perfect Parry, Chun-Li is forced to exit the stance and is in a Punish Counter state during the entire stance exit animation (1f worse PP disadvantage if she holds downback); the final active frame does not move forward (can only achieve the highest frame advantage with meaty timing, not with spacing)

chunli.name: Lotus Fist
chunli.notes: No charge required to cancel into Kikoken or Spinning Bird Kick; exits Serenity Stream upon use; only first hit is an overhead; 1-2f low profile, 1-5f crouching state; 29-42f no head hurtbox; leaves Chun-Li inside throw range after a close range block (very powerful vs. opponents in Burnout)

chunli.name: Forward Strike
chunli.notes: No charge required to cancel into Kikoken or Spinning Bird Kick; [] refers to recovery when exiting Serenity Stream; on Perfect Parry, Chun-Li is forced to exit the stance (5f less total recovery on PP) and is in a Punish Counter state during the entire stance exit animation; when automatically transitioning into Stance Exit, Chun-Li can block for the first 5 transition frames (except on Perfect Parry)

chunli.name: Senpu Kick
chunli.notes: No charge required to cancel into Kikoken or Spinning Bird Kick; [] refers to recovery when exiting Serenity Stream; puts airborne opponents into limited juggle state; special/DR/DI cancel is delayed until after 4th active frame; on Perfect Parry, Chun-Li is forced to exit the stance (6f less total recovery on PP) and is in a Punish Counter state during the entire stance exit animation; when automatically transitioning into Stance Exit, Chun-Li can block for the first 6 transition frames (except on Perfect Parry)

chunli.name: Tenku Kick
chunli.notes: Jump cancelable on hit only; puts opponent into limited juggle state; exits Serenity Stream upon use; 1-6f crouching state

chunli.name: Koshuto
chunli.notes: Has large pushback during throw animation, preventing corner throw loops (with frame-perfect timing, can throw loop vs. Blanka, E. Honda, and Zangief); a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

chunli.name: Taiji Fan
chunli.notes: Side switches; in the corner, does not allow true strike/throw oki without Drive Rush; a successful Throw Escape builds 0.5 Drive bars for the defender; Throw Escape is awarded to a random player if input simultaneously

chunli.name: Ryuseiraku
chunli.notes: Throw height doesn't affect KD advantage, but higher connect will throw opponent farther; no throw oki but can use a ranged meaty strike against cornered opponent

chunli.name: Hosen Kick
chunli.notes: See Drive Impact. Airborne connect gives spinning juggle state on Punish Counter or corner Wall Splat with variable height.

chunli.name: Hoyoku Kick (Block)
chunli.notes: 2 hits; performed by inputting 6HPHK during blockstun; 7f extra recovery on hit; freezes the screen for 4f during startup; if 1st hit is Perfect Parried, opponent can interrupt with a move 11f or faster; see Drive Reversal.

chunli.name: Hoyoku Kick (Recovery)
chunli.notes: 2 hits; performed by inputting 6HPHK on wakeup; 7f extra recovery on hit; does not have any screen freeze except for a 12f freeze when interacting with the opponent's throw hitbox (this also refunds 1 Drive bar after punishing the throw); if 1st hit is Perfect Parried, opponent can interrupt with a move 11f or faster; see Drive Reversal.

chunli.name: Drive Parry
chunli.notes: See Drive Parry. Perfect Parrying has only 1F of recovery and disables the opponent from canceling their attack. Perfect Parrying projectiles puts you into fixed 11 frames of recovery. After a Perfect Parry, all Super Gauge gain is reduced by 20% and Drive Gauge gain/damage is reduced by 50% for the entire punish combo.

chunli.name: Parry Drive Rush
chunli.notes: See Drive Rush; 1-bar version performed out of a Parry; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation (if performed immediately after a successful Parry, only 1+8 startup); the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties; Distance: 1.044 (min/throw), 2.222 (min/block), 3.163 (max/final DR frame)

chunli.name: Drive Rush Cancel
chunli.notes: See Drive Rush; 3-bar version performed on hit/block from a cancelable normal; can also be performed on whiff from cancelable light normals; startup refers to minimum time before an attack can cancel the Drive Rush animation; the first 15 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack; the final 22 recovery frames are cancelable into any attack or movement option or blocking (except Parry); only Normal and Command Normal attacks are enhanced with +4 frame advantage and improved juggle properties

chunli.name: LP Kikoken
chunli.notes: 50f charge (charge lasts 10f after releasing back direction); no charge required if canceled from Stance normals; travels ~90% screen; Super cancel timing is very strict

chunli.name: MP Kikoken
chunli.notes: 50f charge (charge lasts 10f after releasing back direction); no charge required if canceled from Stance normals; travels ~80% screen; Super cancel timing is very strict

chunli.name: HP Kikoken
chunli.notes: 50f charge (charge lasts 10f after releasing back direction); no charge required if canceled from Stance normals; travels ~60% screen; Super cancel timing is very strict

chunli.name: OD Kikoken
chunli.notes: 45f charge (charge lasts 10f after releasing back direction); no charge required if canceled from Stance normals; 2-hit projectile; counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage applies after both hits; 2nd hit with higher juggle limit only comes out if 1st hit connects

chunli.name: LK Hundred Lightning Kicks
chunli.notes: 3 hits; Counter-hit bonus advantage carries through all hits; Punish Counter knockdown puts opponent into a free juggle state (can air reset with a 4f normal in the corner); useful as a 5f punish starter (similar to a shoto 5LK in terms of range); cannot hit cross-up

chunli.name: MK Hundred Lightning Kicks
chunli.notes: 4 hits; counter-hit/Punish Counter bonus advantage carries over through all hits; cannot hit cross-up

chunli.name: HK Hundred Lightning Kicks
chunli.notes: 5 hits; puts opponents into limited juggle state; can juggle into 22K in the corner or SA1/SA3 anywhere (optimal for SA3 damage, skipping the additional damage scaling when canceled); cannot hit cross-up

chunli.name: OD Hundred Lightning Kicks
chunli.notes: 5 hits; can follow-up with KK on hit/block for no extra Drive cost; Counter-hit bonus advantage carries over through all hits; cannot hit cross-up; Punish Counter crumple state gives 11 frames to link a grounded hit, then an additional 23 frames to land a juggle before the opponent is knocked down; airborne Punish Counter puts the opponent into a spinning free juggle state; juggles midscreen after 236HK for solid damage and corner carry

chunli.name: Lightning Kick Barrage
chunli.notes: () refers to scaled damage from 236KK combo starter; 10 hits total; does not cost additional Drive meter; cannot hit cross-up

chunli.name: LK Aerial Hundred Lightning Kicks
chunli.notes: 3 hits; Forward/Neutral Jump only; 3f extra landing recovery on whiff; cannot hit crouching; final 5f landing recovery is in crouching state

chunli.name: MK Aerial Hundred Lightning Kicks
chunli.notes: 4 hits; Forward/Neutral Jump only; 3f extra landing recovery on whiff; cannot hit crouching; final 5f landing recovery is in crouching state

chunli.name: HK Aerial Hundred Lightning Kicks
chunli.notes: 5 hits; Forward/Neutral Jump only; 3f extra landing recovery on whiff; cannot hit crouching; final 5f landing recovery is in crouching state; very strict timing required to hit standing opponent (can hit twice vs. tall characters)

chunli.name: OD Aerial Hundred Lightning Kicks
chunli.notes: 2f extra landing recovery on block/whiff; 6 hits; Forward/Neutral Jump only; cannot hit crouching; no minimum height requirement; better KD Adv. when used in air juggles; entire landing recovery is in crouching state; puts opponent into a limited juggle state (can follow up with grounded juggle after some air connects); safe vs. stand block when input at earliest timing (Tiger Knee motion)

chunli.name: LK Spinning Bird Kick
chunli.notes: 30f charge time (charge lasts 12f after releasing down direction); no charge required if canceled from Stance normals; combos from light normals; cannot hit cross-up

chunli.name: MK Spinning Bird Kick
chunli.notes: 30f charge time (charge lasts 12f after releasing down direction); no charge required if canceled from Stance normals; combos from medium normals; cannot hit cross-up
